strings.当前页面有未保存的更改，确定离开吗？: This page has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
strings.没有识别到语音，请再试一次: No speech was recognized; try once more
strings.麦克风启动失败: The microphone could not be started
strings.方向键移动，回车落笔，Esc 取消: Move with the arrow keys, press Enter to draw, or Escape to cancel
strings.已取消，未保存也未发送任何内容: Cancelled. Nothing was saved or sent.
strings.在浏览器的选择器里选择要采集的窗口或屏幕: Choose the window or screen to capture in the browser picker
strings.拍下当前画面后立即停止屏幕采集: Stop screen capture as soon as the snapshot is taken
strings.只留下框选的区域，其余画面丢弃: Keep the selected region and discard the rest of the image
strings.暂时隐藏标注以对照原图: Hide the annotations to see the original image
strings.屏幕采集被拒绝或未选择来源: Screen capture permission was denied or the picker was cancelled
strings.此浏览器不支持屏幕采集，可选择本地图片: Screen capture is unavailable. Choose a local image to annotate.
strings.没有可导出的图片: There is no image to export
strings.无法确认解说会话: Could not identify the narration session
strings.此浏览器不支持复制图片，请改用“保存图片”: This browser cannot copy images. Use Save image.
strings.此浏览器不支持复制文字，已选中文字，可手动复制: Copy is unavailable. The text is selected for manual copying.
strings.此浏览器无法分享所选内容，请复制或保存: This browser cannot share the selection. Copy or save it instead.
strings.当前构建未包含 GGUF 引擎，请改用支持 GGUF 的构建（如 voicele: This build has no GGUF engine; use a build with one (such as voiceless-vulkan)
strings.上屏未确认，请检查目标输入框: Delivery unconfirmed. Check the target field
strings.后台进程未运行（voiceless daemon）: The daemon is not running (voiceless daemon)
strings.令牌无效，请刷新页面: The session token is no longer valid; reload the page
strings.按下快捷键，说的话会出现在这里: Press the shortcut; what you say appears here
strings.应用已保存的设置。录音进行中时，会等它结束。: Apply the saved settings. A recording in progress is allowed to finish first.
strings.用正在运行的配置替换已保存的设置？此页面的草稿也会丢弃。: Replace the saved settings with the running configuration? The draft on this page is discarded too.
strings.等待空闲后应用设置: The settings are applied once the daemon is idle
strings.设置已保存，等待应用: Settings saved, waiting to be applied
strings.运行 voiceless daemon 开启实时听写: Run the voiceless daemon to enable live dictation
strings.当前构建未包含 CUDA 或 Vulkan: This build has neither CUDA nor Vulkan
strings.未找到有可用驱动的 GPU: No GPU with a usable driver was found
strings.当前构建不支持这个模型: This build cannot run this model
strings.没有已下载的离线模型: No offline model has been downloaded
strings.可用的 GPU 后端，没有就用 CPU: The GPU backend that is available, else the CPU
strings.出字后的目标刷新间隔，耗时较长时会自动放缓: Target interval after each new text; slows down on its own when recognition takes longer
strings.GGUF 最多 60 秒，Sherpa 最多 25 秒: Up to 60 s for GGUF, 25 s for Sherpa
strings.仅本地分段识别使用，需要 gtcrn 模型: Segmented local recognition only; needs the gtcrn model
strings.先用小模型出临时文字: Show interim text from the small model first
strings.要与开通的服务一致: Must match the service you have enabled
strings.设为本地模型，保存后生效: Make this the local model; it takes effect after saving
strings.正在使用的模型不能删除: A model in use cannot be deleted
strings.从本机文件导入 GGUF 模型: Import a GGUF model from a file on this computer
strings.之后要用需要重新导入: you will have to import it again to use it
strings.呃，我去找张三峰聊聊，然后现在，呃，我会给你发一份 receive test。: Uh, I'll go and talk with Zhang Sanfeng, and then right now, uh, I'll send you a receive test.
strings.当前识别后端不使用热词: The current recognizer does not use hotwords
strings.取决于当前模型的词表支持: Depends on the model's vocabulary support
strings.输入一句话试试: Type a sentence to try it
strings.词库文件不得超过 1 MiB: The vocabulary file must be at most 1 MiB
strings.至少两个汉字的热词可用于谐音纠正: Hotwords with at least two Chinese characters can correct sound-alike text
strings.允许该模式将文字发送给已配置的模型: Allow this mode to send text to the configured model
strings.脚本不得超过 16 KiB: The script must be at most 16 KiB
strings.允许脚本读取并改写文字: Allow this script to read and transform text
strings.脚本无法访问文件、网络或系统命令: The script has no access to files, the network, or system commands
strings.允许本机调用提供网站主机名: Allow local callers to provide site hostnames
strings.允许 OpenCode 使用本机输出预览: Allow OpenCode to preview local output
strings.允许本次预览将示例发送给已配置的模型: Allow this preview to send the sample to the configured model
strings.直接输出识别结果，不调用大模型。: Outputs the recognized text as it is, without an LLM.
strings.把下面的内容翻译成自然的英文，只输出译文：{text}: Translate the following into natural English. Output only the translation: {text}
strings.浮层在等待大模型时显示的文字: What the overlay shows while it waits for the LLM
strings.{text} 会被替换为识别结果: {text} is replaced with the recognized text
strings.提示词里没有 {text}，识别结果不会被带进去: The prompt has no {text}; the recognized text will not be inserted
strings.把下面的内容整理成清晰的提示词，只输出提示词：{text}: Turn the following into a clear prompt. Output only the prompt: {text}
strings.或从环境变量读取: or read from an environment variable
strings.按住或点按请录制单键: Record a single key to hold or tap
strings.输入框内实时预编辑: Live preedit in the input field
strings.识别中的文字以预编辑显示在光标处，说完正式上屏: While recognizing, the text shows as preedit at the cursor and is committed when you finish
strings.经输入法提交，和打字同一条路，不占用剪贴板: Committed through the input method, the same way as typing; the clipboard is left alone
strings.只放入剪贴板，由你自己粘贴: Only puts the text on the clipboard; you paste it
strings.模拟按键逐字输入: Types the text key by key
strings.失败时回退剪贴板: Fall back to the clipboard on failure
strings.测试使用的是已保存的设置: The test uses the saved settings
strings.由桌面已启用的 Eww 浮层显示: Shown by the Eww overlay the desktop has enabled
strings.录音状态显示在 Voiceless 窗口中: The Voiceless window shows the recording status.
strings.听写时所在的应用: The application you were dictating into
strings.没有已安装的本地识别模型: No local recognition model is installed
strings.没有找到可以加入词库的差异。: No difference was found to add to the vocabulary.
strings.删除这条记录和它的录音？此操作不能撤销。: Delete this entry and its recording? This cannot be undone.
strings.结束日期不能早于开始日期: The end date cannot be before the start date
strings.搜索原文和最终文字: Search the raw and final text
strings.说一句话，记录就会出现在这里: Say something and the entry appears here
strings.后台进程未运行。可以用 journalctl --user -u voicele: The daemon is not running. Its system logs: journalctl --user -u voiceless
strings.已选中日志，按 Ctrl+C 复制: Logs selected; press Ctrl+C to copy
strings.需要后台进程加载本地模型后才能运行: The daemon has to load the local model before this can run
strings.历史记录中需要有保存了录音的条目: History needs an entry whose recording was saved
strings.平均实时率（识别耗时 ÷ 语音时长，越小越快）: Mean RTF (recognition time ÷ speech time; lower is faster)
strings.平均字错率（以当时的识别原文为参考）: Mean CER (against the text recognized at the time)
strings.红色：参考，绿色：本次: Red: the reference; green this run
strings.允许将这些文件发送给已配置的云端识别服务: Allow these files to be sent to the configured cloud recognizer
strings.文件大小超出转写范围: The file size is outside the supported range
strings.等待实时听写释放识别资源: Waiting for live dictation to finish using the recognizer
strings.移除此任务及其导入的副本？: Remove this job and its imported copy?
strings.安装 FFmpeg 可识别更多格式: Install FFmpeg to open more formats
strings.选择或拖入音视频: Choose or drop audio and video
strings.本地音高估计，待确认: Estimated locally from pitch, awaiting confirmation
strings.保存此段的人工标注: Save the manual label for this segment
strings.选择此段用于整理: Include this segment in the summary
strings.从所选段落提取本地要点: Extract highlights locally from selected segments
strings.发送所选段落并生成要点: Send selected segments and generate highlights
strings.修改所有同名说话人标注: Rename this speaker in every segment
strings.完成轨道转写后可在此选择结果。: Select a track transcript here when it is ready.
strings.尚未配置远程整理服务: No remote summary provider is configured
strings.丢弃此会议已保存的音频？: Discard the audio saved for this meeting?
strings.Linux PipeWire 录制需要 pw-dump、pw-record 和所: Linux recording uses PipeWire. It requires pw-dump, pw-record and access to your selected sources. Local transcription starts when recording ends.
strings.0 表示不限期限或容量。: Set a limit to 0 to keep recordings indefinitely or allow unlimited storage.
strings.待删除的记录已变化，请重新确认: The records selected for deletion have changed. Review them again.
strings.启动守护进程后可重新转写: Start the daemon to transcribe again
strings.等待设置生效: Waiting for the settings to take effect
strings.点击“应用设置”后生效: Takes effect once you click Apply settings
strings.现在按下快捷键，下一次录音会进入试说: Press the shortcut now; the next recording is a practice
strings.等待快捷键超时。请检查“快捷键与上屏”中的绑定，或点“开始试说”。: Timed out waiting for the shortcut. Check the binding in Shortcuts and typing, or select Try a phrase.
strings.请在 3 秒内切换到要测试的输入框: Switch to the field to type into within 3 seconds

patterns.复制图片失败：{}，请改用“保存图片”: Could not copy the image ({}). Use Save image.
patterns.复制文字失败：{}，已选中文字，可手动复制: Could not copy the text ({}). The text is selected for manual copying.
patterns.计算设备回退到 CPU（{}）: Compute fell back to the CPU ({})
patterns.{}；标记为不可用的模型不能选用，也不能导入: {}; models marked unavailable can be neither chosen nor imported
patterns.之后要用需要重新下载 {}: you will have to download {} again to use it
patterns.已选为本地模型 {}，保存并应用后生效: {} is now the chosen local model; it takes effect after you save and apply
patterns.将删除 {} 条文本、{} 段录音和 {} 段失败录音: Transcripts to delete: {}. Recordings: {}. Failed recordings: {}.
